confirmedIssues.title: Saved map overlays colocated listing links without a usable choice
confirmedIssues.precondition: Two saved listings map to the same approximate area coordinates; this is routine because geocoding is by neighborhood text.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: At width 375, save the quiet one-bedroom and long-title shared-room listing from search, open /saved, select 地图.
confirmedIssues.actual: Map claims 2 saved locations but both links occupy the same center. The $850 link paints over the $1,600 link; a tap at either link center resolves to the $850 listing. The lower listing only has approximately five-pixel slivers on either side, and mobile map hides the alternative cards.
confirmedIssues.impact: Guests cannot reliably choose the saved home they see at that location using touch. Equal-price colocated homes would fully hide earlier link hit targets.
evidence: first-journeys.json: map link rectangles and elementFromPoint

confirmedIssues.title: Likes/matches load has no loading state and no in-page recovery after a read failure
confirmedIssues.precondition: Stored session and slow or transiently failing /roommates/activity GET.
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Own browser fixture holds activity GET for 1.8 seconds then returns 503. Open /roommates/likes.
confirmedIssues.actual: While pending the result region is blank, with zero status nodes. After failure only the service-unavailable alert and three tab buttons are present. No reload/retry control is available and switching tabs does not perform another request.
confirmedIssues.impact: Users cannot distinguish loading from an empty page and cannot recover a transient failure within the screen.

confirmedIssues.title: Mobile inbox back-to-list reopens the first conversation so other conversations cannot be chosen
confirmedIssues.precondition: 375px viewport; authenticated synthetic user with at least two conversations
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Own two-conversation browser fixture. Open /inbox/r3-mobile-2, click 返回会话列表, wait for /inbox to finish loading.
confirmedIssues.actual: URL changes to /inbox but the list stays hidden and Conversation 1 opens automatically. The back link cannot lead to a stable list on a fresh /inbox mount.
confirmedIssues.impact: Phone users cannot select another conversation or use list search/filter after opening one.

confirmedIssues.title: Firefox narrow profile expands the document to350px at320px viewport
confirmedIssues.precondition: Firefox browser engine; authenticated account profile at320px viewport
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Own synthetic profile/session browser fixture. Open /account/profile at320px and reload after saving.
confirmedIssues.actual: Document scrollWidth350px; account nav and profile section both334px wide with x16. DOM evidence traces expansion to the implicit grid tracks and textarea native minimum sizing.
confirmedIssues.impact: Profile and logout controls extend offscreen horizontally on narrow Firefox devices or equivalent zoom reflow.

confirmedIssues.title: WebKit modal Escape does not return focus to a mouse-clicked opener
confirmedIssues.precondition: WebKit native default: mouse-clicked buttons are not automatically focused
confirmedIssues.reproduction: Own fresh WebKit browser journey: load /search?view=list, mouse click 筛选, press Escape.
confirmedIssues.actual: Dialog focus enters close button correctly but closing restores the previously focused DIV rather than 筛选. The focus hook can only restore the element active before dialog mount; WebKit did not focus the opener on click.
confirmedIssues.impact: Keyboard use after mouse/touch dismissal loses the expected trigger position. The new saved-map picker would share this issue without explicitly focusing its trigger.
